summary_en: Wellnet acquired 897 restricted shares from eight directors at no cost on October 20, 2026, to correct an overage in the restricted stock award program. The directors had received 30,897 shares in November 2025, exceeding the 30,000-share annual cap set by shareholder resolution. Directors agreed to return the excess shares and related dividend equivalents with 3% interest.
title_en: Notice Regarding Overage in Shareholder Resolution on Restricted Stock Awards and Free Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief:
Wellnet announced on October 20, 2026, that it had inadvertently exceeded a shareholder-approved cap when distributing restricted shares to directors. On November 14, 2025, the company had granted 30,897 shares to eight directors under its restricted stock award program, surpassing the 30,000-share annual limit established at the 35th ordinary shareholder meeting in September 2017. The 897-share overage was distributed to five non-audit directors and three audit committee directors.

To remedy the situation, Wellnet's board of directors resolved on October 20, 2026, to acquire the excess 897 shares free of charge from the eight directors, citing the restricted stock award agreement and provisions of the Companies Act. All eight directors consented to the return. The company also arranged to collect dividend equivalents that the directors had received on the excess shares, together with interest at an annual rate of 3%.

The company stated it would strengthen internal controls to prevent recurrence and expects the matter to have negligible impact on financial results.
